name: cpp-sort
listed_description: Sorting algorithms & related tools for C++14.

name: Timsort
listed_description: A templated stable sorting function which outperforms quicksort-based algorithms including std::sort, for reversed or semi-sorted data.

name: Indiesort
listed_description: A sort wrapper which enables the use of std::sort (& other random-access sort functions) with non-random-access containers, and also improves sort performance for large/non-trivially-copyable types in random-access containers and arrays.
